tagline: Saving lives by improving patient care through oncology diagnostics.
hero_kpi_rationale: NeoGenomics increased its revenue by 10.1% in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting sustained growth in its oncology diagnostic services. This growth is driven by the expansion of the test menu, increasing adoption of advanced diagnostic solutions including molecular testing and NGS, and penetration into the community oncology market.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from all oncology diagnostic services and related offerings.
kpis.description: Total revenue reflects NeoGenomics' overall performance in delivering high-complexity oncology diagnostic services, including molecular testing, NGS, and consulting services.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of commercial growth and demand for oncology diagnostic services.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA increased by 9.5%, or $3.7 million, to $43.4 million in 2025, reflecting improved operational efficiency and cost discipline.
kpis.signal: Measures adjusted operating profitability and cash generation capability.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects NeoGenomics' operational efficiency in delivering its oncology testing services.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin evaluates the company's performance before interest and taxes, showing its ability to generate profit from core operations.
kpis.signal: Measures overall profitability of the company's business activities.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue dedicated to research and development activities.
kpis.description: R&D spending is critical to maintaining a competitive edge in the medical diagnostics sector and developing new oncology tests.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation and development of new diagnostic technologies.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital spending for the acquisition or upgrade of physical assets and laboratory equipment.
kpis.description: Capex is an indicator of NeoGenomics' laboratory infrastructure expansion and modernization.
kpis.signal: Reflects investments in capacity and technology to support future growth.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Headcount reflects NeoGenomics' operational capacity and human resource needs to support business growth.
kpis.signal: Indicator of organizational size and growth.

kpis.name: NGS Testing Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue derived from next-generation sequencing (NGS) services.
kpis.description: NeoGenomics is one of the leading providers of NGS solutions for solid tumors. This metric tracks NGS test growth, reflecting the shift toward precision molecular diagnostics.
kpis.signal: Measures adoption of advanced sequencing technologies and movement toward high-end molecular testing.

kpis.name: MRD Testing Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth from minimal residual disease (MRD) testing, a key innovation segment.
kpis.description: MRD testing represents a strategic growth area for 2026. MRD revenue growth reflects NeoGenomics' positioning in next-generation diagnostic solutions.
kpis.signal: Indicator of adoption of cutting-edge tests and penetration of innovative oncology solutions.

ai_positioning.summary: NeoGenomics integrates advanced diagnostic solutions, including those based on AI and digital pathology, to improve patient care in oncology. The company facilitates the adoption of these technologies in community settings through its leading-edge molecular testing, NGS, and digital pathology services.
evidence: NeoGenomics enables the adoption of these advanced diagnostic tools beyond academic environments into the community setting.

We are continuously improving and expanding our test menu to ensure providers and patients have access to cutting-edge solutions such as advanced molecular testing and state-of-the-art digital pathology.

Our goal for 2026 is to maintain a purpose-driven culture that sustains excellence in service and performance while growing through targeted innovation and further expanding our market relevance in therapy selection and minimal residual disease (MRD).
